fields.id: stable canonical id, domain prefix then snake name
fields.name: display name
fields.unit: count | pct | pp | usd | ratio | days | cycles | multiple
fields.skio: matching Skio UI export fields as section.view.field
fields.aliases: labels the reports use for this metric

metrics.name: Active subscribers
metrics.definition: Distinct customers holding at least one active subscription at a point in time.
metrics.formula: COUNT DISTINCT customer WHERE subscription.status = ACTIVE

metrics.name: Active subscriptions
metrics.definition: Subscriptions in ACTIVE status at a point in time. Differs from subscribers when customers hold several.

metrics.name: Active share of all-time base
metrics.definition: Active subscribers as a share of everyone who has ever subscribed.

metrics.name: All-time subscriptions
metrics.definition: Every subscription ever created on the store, any status.

metrics.name: New subscriptions
metrics.definition: Subscriptions created in the window.
metrics.formula: COUNT subscription WHERE created_at IN window

metrics.name: New subscribers
metrics.definition: Customers whose first subscription started in the window.
metrics.formula: COUNT DISTINCT customer WHERE first_subscription_at IN window

metrics.name: New subscriptions per day
metrics.definition: Run-rate of new subscriptions, used to compare windows of different length.

metrics.name: Cancellations (reported)
metrics.definition: Subscriptions that moved to CANCELLED in the window, from any source.
metrics.formula: COUNT state_change WHERE to_status = CANCELLED AND at IN window

metrics.name: Bulk-operation cancellations
metrics.definition: Cancellations made by a merchant bulk operation rather than by customers. Identified per subscription from the audit event 'Bulk operation finished cancelling subscription'.

metrics.name: Organic cancellations
metrics.definition: Reported cancellations minus bulk-operation cancellations.

metrics.name: Net subscription change (reported)
metrics.definition: New subscriptions minus reported cancellations. Skio's native netChange also counts pause, dunning, resume and recovery transitions, so the two are not identical.

metrics.name: Net subscription change (organic)
metrics.definition: New subscriptions minus organic cancellations.

metrics.name: Reactivations
metrics.definition: Cancelled subscriptions returned to ACTIVE in the window.
metrics.formula: COUNT state_change WHERE from = CANCELLED AND to = ACTIVE

metrics.name: Total store revenue
metrics.definition: All order revenue in the window, subscription and one-time.
metrics.formula: SUM order.total WHERE order not cancelled or deleted

metrics.name: Subscription revenue
metrics.definition: Revenue from orders that carry a subscription, first-time plus recurring.

metrics.name: First-time subscription revenue
metrics.definition: Revenue from the checkout order that starts a subscription.
metrics.formula: SUM order.total WHERE order is the subscription's first order

metrics.name: Recurring subscription revenue
metrics.definition: Revenue from renewal orders created by subscription billing attempts. Excludes the first checkout order.
metrics.formula: SUM order.total WHERE order created by successful billing attempt (errorCode IS NULL)

metrics.name: One-time revenue
metrics.definition: Revenue from orders with no subscription attached. In billing-attempt based splits the first subscription checkout order lands here too.

metrics.name: Subscription share of revenue
metrics.definition: Subscription revenue, first-time plus recurring, as a share of total order revenue.

metrics.name: Recurring share of revenue
metrics.definition: Recurring (renewal) revenue only, as a share of total order revenue. Not comparable with subscription share because first-time orders sit in the denominator only.

metrics.name: First-time share of revenue
metrics.definition: First-time subscription revenue as a share of total revenue.

metrics.name: Orders
metrics.definition: Order count in the window.

metrics.name: First-time subscription orders
metrics.definition: Checkout orders that start a subscription.

metrics.name: Recurring orders
metrics.definition: Renewal orders from successful billing attempts.

metrics.name: Average order value (blended)
metrics.definition: Revenue per order across all order types.

metrics.name: Average order value (recurring)
metrics.definition: Revenue per recurring order.

metrics.name: Revenue per day
metrics.definition: Daily revenue for one revenue type, used for event baselines.

metrics.name: Revenue growth
metrics.definition: Period-over-period change in a revenue measure.

metrics.name: Cancel-flow sessions
metrics.definition: Times a subscriber entered the cancel flow in the window.

metrics.name: Saved sessions
metrics.definition: Sessions that ended with the subscription kept, by any treatment.

metrics.name: Cancelled sessions
metrics.definition: Sessions that ended in cancellation, including compliance-forced cancellations.

metrics.name: Save rate (all sessions)
metrics.definition: Saves divided by every session, including sessions with no recorded outcome.

metrics.name: Save rate (resolved sessions)
metrics.definition: Saves divided by sessions that ended in a save or a cancellation. Sessions abandoned without a decision are left out. Matches Skio's cancel_reason_breakdown Save Rate.

metrics.name: Sessions with no outcome
metrics.definition: Share of sessions ending without a recorded save or cancellation.

metrics.name: Compliance-forced cancellations
metrics.definition: Sessions cancelled immediately to satisfy California click-to-cancel rules, so no offer can be shown.

metrics.name: Offer coverage
metrics.definition: Share of sessions that were shown at least one save offer.

metrics.name: Share of sessions
metrics.definition: Share of all sessions that fall in one slice, such as a reason or billing cycle.

metrics.name: MRR at risk
metrics.definition: Monthly recurring revenue of the subscriptions that entered the cancel flow, valued at the moment of the session.

metrics.name: MRR saved
metrics.definition: Monthly recurring revenue of saved sessions.

metrics.name: MRR lost
metrics.definition: Monthly recurring revenue of cancelled sessions.

metrics.name: MRR save efficiency
metrics.definition: Share of at-risk MRR that was saved. A value-weighted save rate.

metrics.name: Revenue realised after save
metrics.definition: Order revenue actually billed after a saved session, as opposed to the MRR run-rate at risk.
metrics.formula: SUM order revenue after save date for saved sessions

metrics.name: Unique subscribers in cancel flow
metrics.definition: Distinct subscribers with at least one session.

metrics.name: Repeat cancel-attempt rate
metrics.definition: Share of cancel-flow subscribers who opened two or more sessions.

metrics.name: Incremental saves vs baseline rate
metrics.definition: Saves above what the prior period's save rate would have produced on the current resolved volume.

metrics.name: Churn rate (Skio native)
metrics.definition: Skio's own churn rate on the cancel-flow overview. None of the catalogued reports use it.

metrics.name: Day-N retention
metrics.definition: Share of a signup cohort still subscribed N days after each member's own start date.

metrics.name: Share still active
metrics.definition: Share of an ever-subscribed group that is active today. Sensitive to group age.

metrics.name: Share cancelled
metrics.definition: Share of an ever-subscribed group that has cancelled. The complement of share still active, plus paused.

metrics.name: Share cancelled (mature cohort)
metrics.definition: Share cancelled among subscriptions at least 90 days old, removing the youth effect.

metrics.name: Average cycles completed
metrics.definition: Mean number of billing cycles a subscription has completed. Close to Skio's Average Order Count (AOC).

metrics.name: Average lifetime revenue
metrics.definition: Mean revenue per subscription or subscriber to date. A realised, not predicted, LTV.

metrics.name: Windowed LTV (3/6/12 month)
metrics.definition: Revenue per subscriber within a fixed number of months of start. Skio native, unused by the reports.
metrics.formula: SUM revenue within N months / cohort_size

metrics.name: Cumulative cancellation after event
metrics.definition: Share of a group that has cancelled within N days of a trigger event such as a first skip.
metrics.formula: cancelled within N days of event / group_size

metrics.name: One-day mortality
metrics.definition: Share of subscriptions cancelled within a day of creation. Used as a data-hygiene check for imports and test orders.

metrics.name: Cancellation timing mix
metrics.definition: Cancellations grouped by how long after start they happen. Skio native, unused by the reports.

metrics.name: Dunning recovery rate
metrics.definition: Share of resolved dunning cases that ended with the payment recovered.

metrics.name: Recovered dunning cases
metrics.definition: Dunning windows that exited back to ACTIVE.

metrics.name: Lost to dunning
metrics.definition: Dunning windows that ended in cancellation.

metrics.name: Entered dunning
metrics.definition: Dunning windows opened in the window.
metrics.formula: COUNT dunning_window WHERE enteredAt IN window

metrics.name: Open dunning cases
metrics.definition: Dunning windows not yet resolved.
metrics.formula: COUNT dunning_window WHERE exitedAt IS NULL

metrics.name: Backup payment adoption
metrics.definition: Share of the active base with a backup payment method on file.
skio: segments.segments_audit_log.Action[Backup payment method was used for billing]

metrics.name: Recovered revenue
metrics.definition: Revenue billed from recovered dunning windows. Skio native, unused by the reports.

metrics.name: Billing retry funnel
metrics.definition: Outcomes at each billing retry number. Skio native, unused by the reports.

metrics.name: Product subscription revenue
metrics.definition: Subscription revenue attributed to one product or variant.

metrics.name: Product revenue share
metrics.definition: One product's or variant's share of a revenue total.

metrics.name: Product rank
metrics.definition: Ordinal position of a product on a measure.

metrics.name: Product activations
metrics.definition: Subscriptions activated on a product in the window, per Skio's products breakdown.

metrics.name: Product cancellations
metrics.definition: Subscriptions cancelled on a product in the window.

metrics.name: New subscriptions by product
metrics.definition: New subscriptions or subscription lines created on a product or category.

metrics.name: Multi-pack share of new subscriptions
metrics.definition: Share of new subscriptions starting on quantity 2 or more.
metrics.formula: new subs WITH qty >= 2 / new subs

metrics.name: Opt-in interval share
metrics.definition: Share of signups choosing each delivery interval at checkout.

metrics.name: Interval stickiness
metrics.definition: Share of subscriptions still on the interval they opted into.

metrics.name: Interval changes
metrics.definition: Subscriptions that have ever moved off their opt-in interval.

metrics.name: Cadences offered
metrics.definition: Number of distinct delivery intervals on sale.
metrics.formula: COUNT DISTINCT interval in selling plans

metrics.name: Subscriptions by offer
metrics.definition: Subscriptions that used a discount code or offer structure.

metrics.name: New subscriptions by offer share
metrics.definition: Share of recent new subscriptions attributable to each offer.
metrics.formula: new subs WITH offer / new subs

metrics.name: Ever-skipped share
metrics.definition: Share of all subscriptions with at least one recorded skip.

metrics.name: Revenue after first skip
metrics.definition: Revenue billed to skippers after their first skip.
metrics.formula: SUM revenue after first skip date

metrics.name: Portal engagement
metrics.definition: Share of active subscriptions whose subscriber has logged into the customer portal at least once.
metrics.formula: active subs WITH login / active subs

metrics.name: Portal login codes sent
metrics.definition: One-time login codes sent for the customer portal.

metrics.name: Peak-day orders
metrics.definition: Highest single-day order count in an event window.

metrics.name: Peak-day revenue
metrics.definition: Highest single-day revenue for one revenue type in an event window.

metrics.name: Event lift index
metrics.definition: Actual revenue in an event window divided by what the baseline daily rate predicts for the same number of days.

metrics.name: Queued revenue
metrics.definition: Revenue already scheduled from upcoming billing dates. Skio native, unused by the reports.

metrics.name: Projected revenue
metrics.definition: Skio's modelled revenue projection with its error score. Skio native, unused by the reports.

metrics.name: Forecast activations and cancellations
metrics.definition: Projected activations and cancellations with low and high estimates. Skio native, unused by the reports.

metrics.name: Average active subscriptions
metrics.definition: Mean of the daily active subscription count across a period.

metrics.name: Paced full-period revenue
metrics.definition: Quarter-to-date revenue scaled to the full period at the current run-rate. Directional, not a forecast.

metrics.name: Average price by cycle
metrics.definition: Mean order price at each billing cycle, used to rule out post-intro price steps as a churn driver.
metrics.formula: AVG order price BY cycle number

metrics.name: Single-cycle cancel hazard
metrics.definition: Of everyone who reached cycle N, the share who cancelled before reaching cycle N+1.
metrics.formula: cancelled during cycle N / reached cycle N

metrics.name: Average days to cancel
metrics.definition: Mean days from signup to cancellation for subscriptions cancelled at a given cycle.
aliases: Avg. days from signup to cancellation

metrics.name: Cancel reason capture rate
metrics.definition: Share of non-saved cancel-flow sessions with a recorded cancel reason.
metrics.formula: non-saved sessions WITH reason / non-saved sessions

metrics.name: Save reversal rate
metrics.definition: Share of saves that end in cancellation within N days of the save. The complement of save durability.
metrics.formula: saves cancelled within N days / saves
aliases: saves that reverse within N days

metrics.name: Treatment share of saves
metrics.definition: Share of all saves closed by one treatment.

metrics.name: Save rate by reason
metrics.definition: Save rate within one cancel reason. Stored as its own metric when a report quotes it without session counts.

metrics.name: Skip users
metrics.definition: Unique subscribers who used skip at least once.
metrics.formula: COUNT DISTINCT subscriber WITH skip event
aliases: unique subscribers who used skip at least once

metrics.name: Skip events
metrics.definition: Total skip actions including repeats.

metrics.name: Paused subscriptions
metrics.definition: Subscriptions currently in PAUSED status.

metrics.name: Subscription line items by product
metrics.definition: Count of billed subscription line items for a product, all time.
metrics.formula: COUNT order line items WITH subscription line BY product

metrics.name: Co-subscribers for a product pair
metrics.definition: Active subscribers holding both products of a pair.
metrics.formula: COUNT DISTINCT subscriber WITH product A AND product B active

metrics.name: Offers shown
metrics.definition: Times a save offer was displayed in the cancel flow.

metrics.name: Offers claimed
metrics.definition: Times a displayed save offer was accepted.

metrics.name: Offer claim rate
metrics.definition: Share of shown offers that were accepted. Single digits or lower suggest the flow leans on paid offers that do not convert.

metrics.name: Abandoned sessions
metrics.definition: Sessions where the subscriber left the flow without cancelling and without accepting an offer. Some platforms count these as saves.
metrics.formula: COUNT session WHERE no cancel AND no offer accepted

metrics.name: Save rate (platform-reported)
metrics.definition: The save rate a subscription platform's own dashboard shows. Its denominator is often undocumented, so treat it as a standalone figure until the definition is confirmed.

metrics.name: Saves by mechanism
metrics.definition: Saves split into those closed by a claimed offer and those where the subscriber simply left the flow.

metrics.name: Next outcome after a save
metrics.definition: Share of saved subscribers by what their next cancel-flow session did and how soon: cancelled (by time since the save), saved again by the same treatment, saved by another treatment, or never returned.
metrics.formula: subscribers in outcome bucket / saved subscribers (first save per subscriber)
aliases: Outcome measured as the next cancel-flow session
Later saved by a different action

metrics.name: Same-visit save reversal
metrics.definition: Share of saves followed by a cancellation within 10 minutes of the save, in the same visit. The save did not hold even for the session.
metrics.formula: saves re-entered and cancelled within 10 min / saves
aliases: Re-entered flow and cancelled within 10 min (same visit)

metrics.name: Skips per skip user
metrics.definition: Average number of skips per subscriber who skipped at least once.

metrics.name: Time between consecutive skips
metrics.definition: Time from one skip to the next by the same subscriber, as a distribution over time buckets, restricted to subscribers who skipped at least that many times.
metrics.formula: COUNT subscribers by elapsed bucket between skip k and skip k+1

metrics.name: Recurring orders after a save
metrics.definition: Recurring orders on the saved subscription after the save, as a mean or a distribution (0, 1, 2, 3+), counted only through the same subscription line.
metrics.formula: COUNT DISTINCT orders on the same line after the save / saved subscribers
aliases: Recurring Orders Placed After First Skip

metrics.name: Reorder milestone rate after a save
metrics.definition: Share of saved subscribers who reach their 1st, 2nd or 3rd recurring order after the save.
metrics.formula: subscribers reaching milestone N / saved subscribers

metrics.name: Time to reorder after a save
metrics.definition: Median days from the save to the next recurring order, or between reorder milestones.
metrics.formula: MEDIAN days(save or prior milestone -> next recurring order)
aliases: Typical Time to Reach (from prior milestone)

metrics.name: Share by current status
metrics.definition: Share of a group in each current subscription status: active, cancelled, failed payment (dunning) or paused.

metrics.name: Median time to cancel after an event
metrics.definition: Median time from a trigger event, such as a first skip, to cancellation, among those who cancelled.
aliases: Median time from skip to cancellation

metrics.name: Average days since the event
metrics.definition: Mean age of a cohort measured from its trigger event to the report date. Shows how much time the cohort has had to reach an outcome.

metrics.name: Merchant cancellations
metrics.definition: Cancellations entered by the merchant team from the platform dashboard, which never show the customer an offer.
